title: Modern Dream Home Heated Pool Hot Tub 6BR 9 Beds
description:
Private Home on a Half Acre lot in the most coveted neighborhood in Phoenix - Arcadia Proper! 9 Beds (8 total king beds, 1 Queen bed), 6 BR w/ 6 En-Suite Baths. Located between the Night Life of Old Town Scottsdale & Fine Dining of Arcadia Phoenix. High Ceilings, Light and Bright, California Modern Design, Highest End Finishes. Heated Pool to 82° optional at $100 per night. Hot Tub to 102°. Rooftop Camelback MTN Viewing Deck. Home appraises for over $5 Million. This is the one!

 The space 
We conduct tenant screening using Safely. You will receive a message that says, "I give permission to the property manager to use a third-party to screen my identity and check criminal databases to confirm my reservation. Complete terms regarding the guest screening can be provided by the property manager. You may receive an email to complete your screening. Please check your spam inbox for this email and contact the property manager if you have any questions."

*Important Disclosure Before Booking*
Every guest is required to review the terms and conditions associated with leasing this property. You will receive a link to click, review, and sign after you confirm your reservation on the booking channel. Please review the cancellation policy before reserving as well. 
Please do not reserve if you are uncomfortable signing our terms and conditions required to stay at this home. If you want to review them before booking, just inquire and ask for a copy of the terms and conditions form.
